claimed_purpose.text: The tool corrects a prior pipeline (split-memories.mjs) whose AI-generated splits were 36% paraphrase rather than verbatim, and replaces them with mechanically windowed archive entries and quote-verified extracts.
Embedding component for a memory system called Raffaello

mechanisms.text: Message log vs curated memory: raw conversation messages are read from per-conversation JSON files and used as source material; only LLM-selected, quote-verified facts are written to the memory store — not the full transcript

Two storage layers are distinguished: 'archive' (chat_archive) for mechanical sliding-window slices of raw vault text, and 'vault-extract' for curated, AI-extracted facts with verbatim quote citations.
The assistant's reply is scanned for <mem> tags after each turn; if found, the text is posted to a local ingest endpoint at port 3800 to write curated facts into the memory store.
Uses BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 via fastembed to produce vector embeddings, backed by ChromaDB's EmbeddingFunction interface, suggesting chromadb as the vector store layer
Archive windows are written by posting to /archive-ingest with replace_conv, enabling idempotent replacement of all windows belonging to a vault document.
Certain chat-dir files are explicitly excluded from ingestion by filename (settings.json, memory.json, gateway-stats.json, any backup file)
Inject applies a relative distance filter: results are kept only if within 0.15 of the best hit and below a hard 0.65 junk cutoff.
Memories are stored to ChromaDB via a local memory-gateway; this script only writes, not reads — retrieval is handled elsewhere
Vault entries are identified by an 'id' prefix of 'vault:', distinguishing them from other memory types in the same collection.
Canonical tag state is stored in meta.db, not in ChromaDB metadata; this was discovered as a discrepancy during development.
Isolation is per conversation: state tracks extractedUpTo per convId, and stored memories carry conversation_id
Delete path: POST /delete removes a memory by id from both ChromaDB and SQLite

ledger.claim: Full conversation transcript is persisted to disk as a JSON file per conversation and never deleted during normal operation; compression advances a read pointer rather than removing records.
ledger.quote:
// 2026-06-11: anchor-based window — don't delete old messages (keeps
// raw archive intact). Just advance cycleStart past summarized msgs.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Session summary (BP3) is a curated compression of older turns, separate from the raw log, and is what the model receives as 'conversation context' once the window advances.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Memory injection uses a two-query-lane strategy: the user's recent context and the assistant's previous reply are both sent to the memory gateway, so what the AI just said influences what is retrieved next turn.
ledger.quote:
// 2026-06-12: echo = the assistant's previous reply, sent as a second query
// lane ("回复的余味") — what the AI just said shapes what surfaces next turn.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Curated memory write path is triggered by <mem> tags in the assistant's output; the text is posted to an ingest service, making extraction model-side and tag-driven rather than automatic.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Vault diary/memo entries are filtered by category and recency (last 2 days) and truncated before injection; the injected form is lossy (800-char cap for diaries, 400-char for memos).
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Recall tool provides on-demand retrieval from both vault (curated facts) and archive (verbatim transcripts) layers, with exact/semantic modes and date/conv_id scoping.
ledger.quote: description: '搜索你们的长期记忆并返回原文。两层数据：vault（精选记忆条目）+ archive（全部聊天原文的逐字存档），语义检索默认两层都搜。'
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Edit operations that truncate the message log reset the cycleStart anchor and clear instantSummary, preventing a stale summary from being served for a now-shorter history.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Memory injection is skipped entirely when there is no recent user context, and degrades silently to empty injection on timeout or error rather than blocking the response.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: L0 is a named architectural layer representing the raw-archive source of truth, combining verbatim vault entries and chat messages for exact-recall queries
ledger.quote: L0 = source of truth: vault entries + API chat conversation messages, indexed verbatim for exact-recall ("she said it exactly how?")
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Vault entries and chat messages are distinguished by source tag ('vault:<category>' vs 'chat'), allowing downstream retrieval to differentiate curated memory from raw log
ledger.quote:
(content, 'vault:' + e.get('category', ''), ...)
...
(t, 'chat', f'{conv_id}:{i}', date, m.get('role', ''))
ledger.locator: main(), vault and chat INSERT statements
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: A separate memory.json file exists in the chat data directory but is explicitly excluded from L0 indexing, suggesting it serves a different (possibly higher-layer) memory role
ledger.quote:
if base in ('settings.json', 'memory.json', 'gateway-stats.json') or 'backup' in base:
    continue
ledger.locator: main(), chat file loop, skip-list guard
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The memory system is named Raffaello and uses BGE-small-zh embeddings as its vector representation layer
ledger.quote: BGE-small-zh embedding for Raffaello memory system.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: ChromaDB is used as the vector store backing the memory system
ledger.quote: from chromadb.api.types import EmbeddingFunction, Documents, Embeddings
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The embedding model used is BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5, a Chinese-language model, suggesting the memory system targets Chinese-language content
ledger.quote: _model = TextEmbedding("BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5")
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Extraction runs periodically and only when a conversation has at least 4 unprocessed messages
ledger.quote: const MIN_NEW_MESSAGES = 4; // minimum unprocessed messages before extracting
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Full conversation transcript is never stored; only LLM-curated fact/event summaries with verbatim source quotes are persisted
ledger.quote: 你的工作是「摘录」不是「创作」：圈出对话里值得记住的信息点，并为每条附上原文引用。
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Quote-verification guard drops any memory whose required quote string cannot be found verbatim in the batch source, targeting hallucination and memory-echo
ledger.quote: quote must appear verbatim in the batch source text — kills hallucinations and most memory-echo (retellings of old events have no literal source in the current batch).
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Superseded (contradicted/updated) memories are not deleted; they remain in the DB but are removed from ranking, and the operation is reversible by clearing superseded_by
ledger.quote: Superseded memories leave ranking but stay in the DB (reversible: clear superseded_by).
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Pinned memories are never auto-superseded regardless of contradiction confidence
ledger.quote: Pinned memories are sacred and never auto-superseded.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Relationship edge model uses DS V3 to classify relationships between new and existing memories; edges with confidence ≥ 0.5 are written to a JSONL file
ledger.quote: const edgeLine = JSON.stringify({ source: memId, target: edge.target_id, relation_type: edge.relation, confidence: Math.round(conf * 100) / 100, reason: (edge.reason || '').slice(0, 100), created_at: now, }); appendFileSync(EDGES_PATH, edgeLine + '\n');
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Memory isolation is per conversation; extraction state and conversation_id are tracked per convId
ledger.quote: state[convId] = { extractedUpTo: endIdx, lastExtracted: new Date().toISOString(), title: conv.title || '', };
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: This file handles only the write path (extract + store); retrieval into the turn context is not implemented here
ledger.quote: Stores into ChromaDB via memory-gateway /ingest-extracted endpoint.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Memory gateway persists curated memories in ChromaDB (vectors) and SQLite (metadata) as dual stores, distinct from a full transcript archive in raw-archive.db and a chat_archive ChromaDB collection.
ledger.quote:
_client = chromadb.PersistentClient(path=VEC_PATH)
_col = _client.get_or_create_collection("raffaello_memory", ...)
_archive_col = _client.get_or_create_collection("chat_archive", ...)
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Injection into the prompt is split into a static layer (profiles, always included) and a dynamic layer (keyword-filtered facts + semantic index lines), with the semantic layer limited to one-line summaries per hit.
ledger.quote:
# Semantic search — index only (2026-06-11): one line per hit instead of
# full documents (~150 tok vs ~1000+).
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Write path for inline memories uses <mem> tag extraction from assistant replies; these are stored in ChromaDB only, not in the SQLite meta store or vault.
ledger.quote: # Store only in ChromaDB (gateway injection), not vault
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Conflict/supersession is handled by marking absorbed memories with a superseded_by field rather than deleting them; they are excluded at retrieval scoring time.
ledger.quote: """Mark absorbed memories as superseded by keep_id. Does not delete them."""
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Hard delete removes a memory from both ChromaDB and SQLite simultaneously via the /delete endpoint.
ledger.quote:
try: _col.delete(ids=[mem_id])
except: pass
db = get_db()
db.execute('DELETE FROM memories WHERE id = ?', (mem_id,))
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Retrieve policy is adaptive: injection uses a relative distance filter (best+0.15, hard 0.65 cap) so low-relevance memories are withheld rather than always injected.
ledger.quote:
# Relative filter (2026-06-10): natural-sentence queries sit at dist
# 0.5-0.6 with bge-small-zh, so a hard 0.45 cutoff starved injection.
# Keep results within 0.15 of the best hit, hard junk line at 0.65.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Access tracking distinguishes injection-path retrieval (not counted) from tool-call retrieval (increments access_count and writes to recall_log).
ledger.quote: # only a real recall (tool call) counts as "remembered".
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Temporal validity windows provide a soft forget mechanism: post-expiry memories decay exponentially in score but are not deleted; pre-validity memories receive a gentle penalty.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Write-time deduplication merges incoming memories with cosine similarity >0.75 into the existing record rather than storing duplicates.
ledger.quote:
if sim > 0.75:
    existing_doc = similar['documents'][0][i]
    merged_text = existing_doc + '\n' + text if len(existing_doc) < 2000 else text
    _col.upsert(ids=[sid], documents=[merged_text], ...)
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The echo lane queries memory using the assistant's previous reply as a second query vector, surfacing memories relevant to what was just said rather than only what the user asked.
ledger.quote:
echo: the assistant's previous reply ("回复的余味", 2026-06-12) — a second
query lane so what the AI just said shapes what surfaces next turn.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Two memory layers exist: a mechanical sliding-window archive (chat_archive, zero AI) and a curated AI-extracted vault-extract layer with verbatim quote verification.
ledger.quote:
phase l0     全部 vault 原文机械切窗 → chat_archive（装订工配方，零 AI）
  phase l1     split-done 的 vault 长文跑摘录管线（圈重点+逐字引用+机械校验）
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Archive windows are written with replace_conv semantics, making phase l0 idempotent by replacing all prior windows for a given vault document.
ledger.quote: r = post("/archive-ingest", {"replace_conv": d["id"], "windows": wins})
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Extracted memory items are stored with a verbatim quote field linking each curated fact back to its source text.
ledger.quote:
r = post("/ingest-extracted", {
                    "document": it["content"], "date": it.get("date") or date,
                    "source": "vault-extract", "conversation_id": d["id"],
                    "quote": it.get("quote", "")})
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Extracted items that fail verbatim quote verification are dropped before ingestion, not stored.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Tag authority resides in meta.db (SQLite), not in ChromaDB; ChromaDB metadata does not carry tags, discovered 2026-06-12.
ledger.quote: # tags 权威在 meta.db，chroma 元数据里没有（2026-06-12 验出）
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: A prior extraction pipeline (split-memories.mjs using DS V3) produced 36% paraphrase rather than verbatim content, motivating the re-extraction with quote guards.
ledger.quote: 产物没有逐字校验，36% 是转述（见 verify-splits-report.json）
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Vault documents are scoped per conversation (conv_id) and per source type (vault: prefix), establishing a form of isolation by conversation within the shared collection.
ledger.quote: if i.startswith("vault:"):

ledger.claim: Semantic retrieval returns cosine-distance-ranked results from ChromaDB using BGEZh embeddings; caller controls result count via n parameter
ledger.quote: results = _col.query(query_texts=[query], n_results=min(n, count))

ledger.claim: Upsert (not append-only) write semantics: re-embedding the same id overwrites the prior vector and metadata in both stores

_col.upsert(ids=[mem_id], documents=[text], metadatas=[metadata])
...INSERT OR REPLACE INTO memories

ledger.claim: Hard delete removes a memory from both vector and relational stores; no soft-delete or hide-at-retrieve mechanism is present in this file
ledger.label: measured
